name: RLLpIncentive pays accrued LP rewards on the current LP balance
summary: RLLpIncentive.distributeAirdrop(user) is public and pays (globalIndex - usersIndex[user]) times the user's current RL/USDT LP balance, while LP transfers never checkpoint the index. The attacker registered claimer contracts a day early with zero LP, then with flash-loaned USDT added liquidity and passed the same LP through each claimer, collecting the whole period's reward on the full position every time, and sold the RL into the pair.
notes: Before the anchor the incentive paid 140k RL in 112 transactions, within its 5,000 RL/day emission; the attacker's claimer-registration transactions (e.g. 0xf91478b3) moved no funds. The owner's setAirdropStartTime only opened the airdrop (rule 8) and ownership was renounced two months before the exploit.
The incentive's RL (758k in the anchor, 3.76M in the attacker's repeat) is unpriced; loss is the USDT the attacker realised from the RL/USDT pair 0xd9578d40 (rule 12).
